European Patent Application
Publication No.: EP 3561239 A1
Title: Fusion protein for programmable base editing and method for producing the same
Applicant: Novastrand Therapeutics, Inc.
Filing Date: 3 September 2018
Int. Cl. / CPC: C12N15/11; C12N9/22

Abstract: A fusion protein for programmable base editing is disclosed. The fusion protein for programmable base editing comprises a Cas9 nickase domain fused to an engineered TadA-8e adenosine deaminase domain via a 32-amino-acid linker. The disclosed arrangement addresses off-target deamination at genomic sites resembling the protospacer.

Claims:
1. A fusion protein for programmable base editing, comprising a Cas9 nickase domain fused to an engineered TadA-8e adenosine deaminase domain via a 32-amino-acid linker.
2. The protein according to claim 1, wherein the fusion protein further comprises two bipartite nuclear localisation signals.
3. The protein according to claim 1, wherein the on-target editing efficiency is 68% in primary human hepatocytes.
</document>

United States Patent Application Publication
Publication No.: US 2020/289732 A1
Title: Method of training a machine-learning model across client devices
Applicant: Koninklijke Philips N.V.
Filing Date: 16 February 2019
CPC: G06N3/098

Claims:
1. A method of training a machine-learning model across client devices, comprising applying per-client gradient clipping to a fixed L2 norm before adding Gaussian noise calibrated to a per-round privacy budget.
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein client updates are combined under a secure aggregation protocol such that the server observes only the sum.
3. The method according to claim 1, wherein the accuracy drop is 1.9 percentage points versus centralised training.
4. An apparatus for training a machine-learning model across client devices, the apparatus comprising a controller configured to perform the step of applying per-client gradient clipping to a fixed L2 norm before adding Gaussian noise calibrated to a per-round privacy budget.
5. The apparatus according to claim 4, wherein client updates are combined under a secure aggregation protocol such that the server observes only the sum.
6. The apparatus according to claim 4, wherein the accuracy drop is 1.9 percentage points versus centralised training.
7. A non-transitory computer-readable medium storing instructions which, when executed by a processor, cause the processor to perform the step of applying per-client gradient clipping to a fixed L2 norm before adding Gaussian noise calibrated to a per-round privacy budget.
8. The medium according to claim 7, wherein client updates are combined under a secure aggregation protocol such that the server observes only the sum.
9. The medium according to claim 7, wherein the accuracy drop is 1.9 percentage points versus centralised training.
</document>

United States Patent Application Publication
Publication No.: US 2022/363367 A1
Title: Membrane electrode assembly for water electrolysis and method of manufacture thereof
Applicant: Helion Elektrolyte GmbH
Filing Date: 17 May 2021
Int. Cl. / CPC: C25B1/04; C25B11/081

A membrane electrode assembly for water electrolysis is provided, comprising an anode catalyst layer having an iridium loading of 0.15 mg/cm2 to 0.35 mg/cm2 supported on antimony-doped tin oxide. Such an assembly addresses the scarcity of iridium at the anode, which presents a limitation to the deployment of terawatt-scale electrolysers.

Claims:
1. A membrane electrode assembly for water electrolysis, comprising an anode catalyst layer having an iridium loading of 0.15 mg/cm2 to 0.35 mg/cm2 supported on antimony-doped tin oxide.
2. The assembly according to claim 1, wherein the proton-exchange membrane has a thickness of 50 um to 90 um and a reinforcing expanded-PTFE layer.
3. The assembly according to claim 1, wherein the cell voltage is 1.72 V at 2 A/cm2.
</document>

Title: Monolithic tandem photovoltaic device and method of manufacture thereof
Inventors: Chidi Okonkwo; Rajesh Menon
Applicant: (none recorded)
Filing Date: 4 November 2021
CPC: H10K30/50

A monolithic tandem photovoltaic device is provided that includes a textured silicon bottom cell and a wide-bandgap perovskite top cell. The perovskite top cell is deposited on the textured silicon bottom cell and exhibits a bandgap in a range of 1.66 eV to 1.72 eV. The top cell and the bottom cell are configured in a monolithic tandem arrangement to form the photovoltaic device.

Title: Method of training a machine-learning model across client devices

Filing Date: 2 October 2018
Int. Cl. / CPC: G06N3/098; G06N3/045

Abstract: A method of training a machine-learning model across client devices is disclosed. The method of training a machine-learning model across client devices comprises applying per-client gradient clipping to a fixed L2 norm before adding Gaussian noise calibrated to a per-round privacy budget. The disclosed arrangement addresses the accuracy cost of noise addition when client data are non-identically distributed.

Claims:
1. A method of training a machine-learning model across client devices, comprising applying per-client gradient clipping to a fixed L2 norm before adding Gaussian noise calibrated to a per-round privacy budget.
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein client updates are combined under a secure aggregation protocol such that the server observes only the sum.
3. The method according to claim 1, wherein the accuracy drop is 1.9 percentage points versus centralised training.

Title: Control system for a quantum processor and method of manufacture thereof

A control system for a quantum processor comprises a real-time syndrome decoder implemented in field-programmable logic. The decoder returns a correction within one surface-code cycle for a code distance of at least 7. The decoder operates with a throughput sufficient to match the syndrome extraction rate, thereby avoiding a backlog that would otherwise destroy the logical qubit.

Claims:
1. A control system for a quantum processor, comprising a real-time syndrome decoder implemented in field-programmable logic and configured to return a correction within one surface-code cycle for a code distance of at least 7.
2. The system according to claim 1, wherein the decoder applies a correlated-noise weighting derived from a calibration of two-qubit gate errors.
3. The system according to claim 1, wherein the logical error rate per cycle is 1.4e-4 at distance 7.
</document>

A control system for a quantum processor comprises a real-time syndrome decoder implemented in field-programmable logic. European Patent Application
Publication No.: EP 4100419 A1
Title: Coherent optical ranging system and method of manufacture thereof
Applicant: Beamforge Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
Filing Date: 22 May 2022
CPC: G01S17/34

Background: US9245860B2 (assigned to Lumenex Photonics KK) describes a coherent optical ranging system in which a conventional arrangement is used. That approach does not resolve the cost and reliability penalty of mechanically scanned time-of-flight LiDAR in automotive service. The present application instead relies on a silicon-photonic optical phased array configured to steer a frequency-chirped beam without a moving part, and a balanced photodetector pair for coherent detection.
</document>

European Patent Application
Publication No.: EP 4172302 A1
Title: Positive electrode active material and method of manufacture thereof
Applicant: BASF SE
Filing Date: 16 August 2022
CPC: H01M4/5825

Claims:
1. A positive electrode active material, comprising carbon-coated LiFe(1-x)MnxPO4 particles wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.45 and the carbon coating has a thickness of 2 nm to 6 nm.
2. The material according to claim 1, wherein the particles have a tap density of at least 1.4 g/cm3.
3. The material according to claim 1, wherein the discharge capacity is 158 mAh/g at 1C and 25 degrees C.
4. A method of manufacturing a positive electrode active material, the method comprising forming carbon-coated LiFe(1-x)MnxPO4 particles wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.45 and the carbon coating has a thickness of 2 nm to 6 nm.
5. The method according to claim 4, wherein the particles have a tap density of at least 1.4 g/cm3.
6. The method according to claim 4, wherein the discharge capacity is 158 mAh/g at 1C and 25 degrees C.
</document>

PCT International Publication
Publication No.: WO 2020/156491 A1
Title: Vapour-compression heat pump and method of manufacture thereof
Applicant: Robert Bosch GmbH
International Filing Date: 27 August 2019
CPC: F25B30/02

Technical Field: The present disclosure relates to low-GWP refrigerant heat pumps.
Abstract: There is provided a vapour-compression heat pump comprising a propane refrigerant circuit having a total charge of less than 150 g and a microchannel evaporator with an internal volume of less than 0.4 L. The disclosure thereby addresses the flammability charge limits that restrict hydrocarbon refrigerants in domestic installations.
</document>

European Patent Application
Publication No.: EP 3601773 A1
Title: All-solid-state lithium secondary battery and method of manufacture thereof
Applicant: QuantumScape Battery, Inc.
Filing Date: 5 January 2018
CPC: H01M10/0562

Background: US10379751B2 (assigned to Samsung SDI Co., Ltd.) describes an all-solid-state lithium secondary battery in which a conventional arrangement is used. That approach does not resolve lithium dendrite penetration through the electrolyte at practical current densities. The present application instead relies on a solid electrolyte layer comprising an argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl having a median particle diameter D50 of 0.8 um to 2.5 um.
</document>

European Patent Application
Publication No.: EP 3900590 A1
Title: Fusion protein for programmable base editing and method for producing the same
Applicant: The Broad Institute, Inc.
Filing Date: 28 September 2020
CPC: C12N15/11

Background: US9250337B2 (assigned to Novastrand Therapeutics, Inc.) describes a fusion protein for programmable base editing in which a conventional arrangement is used. That approach does not resolve off-target deamination at genomic sites resembling the protospacer. The present application instead relies on a Cas9 nickase domain fused to an engineered TadA-8e adenosine deaminase domain via a 32-amino-acid linker.
</document>

PCT International Publication
Publication No.: WO 2022/147475 A1
Title: Method of transferring micro light-emitting diodes to a backplane
Applicant: Applied Materials, Inc.
International Filing Date: 21 June 2021
CPC: H01L25/0753

Technical Field: The present disclosure relates to microLED mass-transfer processes.
Abstract: There is provided a method of transferring micro light-emitting diodes to a backplane comprising picking up an array of micro light-emitting diodes having a lateral dimension of less than 30 um with an elastomeric stamp whose adhesion is modulated by peel rate. The disclosure thereby addresses the defect rate of transferring millions of dies per panel at commercially viable throughput.
</document>
